_readme: SAMPLE reviews for layout only. Each card shows a Sample review tag while sample is true. Before launch replace with real Google reviews (verbatim, with permission): set name, date (e.g. Google review, March 2026) and sample: false.

items.text: Our water heater gave out on a Sunday night with a house full of guests. Someone actually picked up the phone, a technician showed up the next morning, and we had hot water by lunch. He explained the options without pushing the most expensive one.
items.name: Sample Customer A

items.text: Kitchen drain had been slow for months. They ran a camera, showed me grease buildup about twenty feet down, cleared it and showed me the clean pipe afterward. Shoe covers on, floor wiped when they left.
items.name: Sample Customer B

items.text: We manage several older apartment buildings and need a plumber who answers after hours. They handle our tenant calls, send clear invoices and keep us updated with photos. That is rare.
items.name: Sample Customer C

items.text: Pipe burst in the crawl space during the cold snap. They talked me through shutting off the main on the phone and had someone there within a couple of hours. Fair price, quoted before they started.
items.name: Sample Customer D

items.text: Our restaurant's floor drains backed up during a Friday dinner rush. They came after close, jetted the line and set us up on a maintenance schedule. No problems since.
items.name: Sample Customer E

items.text: Had a running toilet and a dripping tub faucet. Small jobs, but they treated them like they mattered. On time, polite, and the price matched the quote exactly.
items.name: Sample Customer F

items.text: Bought an old house and wanted the sewer line checked before closing. The camera inspection found a root intrusion and they gave us a written summary we used in negotiations.
items.name: Sample Customer G

items.text: Sump pump died during the spring thaw. They swapped it the same day and added a battery backup so we are covered next time the power goes out.
items.name: Sample Customer H

items.text: Clear communication from the first call to the final invoice. The technician answered every question and didn't rush us. We will call them first from now on.
items.name: Sample Customer I
